headline: UAE Considers Third Pipeline to Bypass Strait of Hormuz
summary: The United Arab Emirates is reportedly weighing plans for a third crude export pipeline to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, expanding capacity and reducing exposure to potential disruptions.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical global energy chokepoint through which a large portion of the world's petroleum passes. Infrastructure projects altering transit routes affect geopolitical risk premiums and supply security for international crude markets.
